en.summary: Fixes a shared-memory store commit bug by asserting each bank RAM write-enable only when the queued request is actually dequeued.
why_it_counts: The functional change is in shared-memory RTL, not tooling or tests.
The patch corrects when the banked scratchpad array is allowed to write.
The old behavior could write while a request was still stalled in the queue.
disqualifiers: VX_lsu_unit only has a debug-print formatting change.
evidence: VX_shared_mem adds a per-bank wren signal.
The RAM write-enable changes from valid && rw to valid && rw && creq_pop.
creq_pop is the queue dequeue event for the shared-memory request.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a queued banked scratchpad or shared-memory design, a store must update the RAM array only when the request is actually accepted or dequeued. If the write-enable depends only on the queued request being present, a stalled head entry can rewrite the same location across multiple cycles or write before the control path has committed the operation.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A banked shared-memory write sits at the head of a request queue while dequeue or response progress is stalled.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow the bank RAM write-enable to assert from queued request valid/rw alone, without requiring the dequeue or commit handshake.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop commit/dequeue guard from RAM write-enable
portability_notes: Apply this to any banked SRAM, scratchpad, or shared-memory block with queued requests.
The key signal is the event that advances or retires the request, not the source-side valid signal.
If the design uses per-bank write strobes, mutate those strobes instead of unrelated address or data logic.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that generates the per-bank store write-enable after request arbitration or queueing.
Identify the handshake or dequeue term that proves the request is being consumed this cycle.
Remove that term so the write-enable remains high whenever the queued entry is a valid store.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix introduces a local wren signal and adds creq_pop to each bank RAM write-enable so queued stores write only on dequeue.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_shared_mem, the bank RAM .wren input was changed from per_bank_core_req_valid[i] && per_bank_core_req_rw[i] to a local wren that also requires creq_pop.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Shared-memory stores can commit on stalled cycles, causing repeated writes, early writes, or data corruption when backpressure holds a queued store in place.
evidence_for_injection: The only functional RTL change in VX_shared_mem is the added creq_pop term on RAM writes.
The request queue already exposes creq_pop as the consume event for the queued request.
The debug-only change in VX_lsu_unit is unrelated to the memory behavior fix.
notes: This is a clean single-mechanism fault and is directly injectable by a reverse edit.
The bug is independent of the debug-print hunk in the same commit.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 shared memory 存储提交时机错误，使每个 bank 的 RAM 写使能只在队列请求真正出队时才触发。
why_it_counts: 功能性修改位于 shared-memory RTL，而不是工具或测试。
补丁修正了 banked scratchpad 阵列何时允许写入。
旧逻辑会在请求仍停在队列头部时提前写入。
disqualifiers: VX_lsu_unit 只有调试打印格式调整。
evidence: VX_shared_mem 为每个 bank 新增了局部 wren 信号。
RAM 写使能从 valid && rw 改成 valid && rw && creq_pop。
creq_pop 就是 shared-memory 请求的队列出队事件。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带请求队列的 banked scratchpad 或 shared-memory 设计中，store 只有在请求被真正接受或出队时才应更新 RAM。如果写使能只依赖“队列里存在一个有效写请求”，那么队列头被阻塞时会在多个周期重复写同一地址，或者在控制路径尚未提交前就提前写入。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 队列化 shared-memory store 的提交门控
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个 banked shared-memory 写请求停在队列头，同时出队或响应前进被阻塞。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 bank RAM 的写使能只由队列中的 valid/rw 决定，而不要求出队或提交握手。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 从 RAM 写使能中删除 commit/dequeue 条件
portability_notes: 可应用于任何带请求队列的 banked SRAM、scratchpad 或 shared-memory 模块。
关键是表示“本周期真正消费该请求”的事件，而不是源端 valid。
如果设计使用 per-bank 写 strobe，应直接修改该 strobe 的门控逻辑。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到仲裁或排队之后生成每个 bank store 写使能的逻辑。
识别能证明该请求在本周期被消费的握手或出队项。
删除该项，使写使能在队列头是有效写请求时持续为高。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Per-bank shared-memory RAM 写使能生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复为每个 bank 引入局部 wren，并在 RAM 写使能中加入 creq_pop，使队列化 store 只在出队时写入。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_shared_mem 中，bank RAM 的 .wren 从 per_bank_core_req_valid[i] && per_bank_core_req_rw[i] 改为还要求 creq_pop 的局部 wren。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: shared-memory store 会在阻塞周期错误提交，导致重复写、提前写或在背压下损坏数据。
evidence_for_injection: VX_shared_mem 中唯一的功能性 RTL 修复就是在 RAM 写入上增加 creq_pop。
请求队列本身已经把 creq_pop 作为消费该请求的事件。
同一提交里的 VX_lsu_unit 改动只是调试输出，不影响存储行为。
notes: 这是一个很干净的单机制故障，可直接通过反向编辑注入。
该缺陷与同提交中的调试打印修改无关。
